language.label: Language
language.helper: Applies to dates and amounts as well as to the interface.

workspace.noneDescription: Your account is not a member of any workspace. Ask an admin for an invitation, or create one.
workspace.noneDescriptionSwitcher: Your account is not a member of any workspace. Ask an admin for an invitation, or create one from the switcher above.

errors.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond.
errors.parsing: The server returned an unexpected response.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.

auth.signInSubtitle: Welcome back. Enter your details to continue.
auth.createSubtitle: Registering also sets up your first workspace, with a starter category tree.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.passwordHintShort: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers

dashboard.noActivity: No activity in this period yet.
dashboard.largestCategory: Largest: {{name}} at {{amount}} ({{percent}}% of the month’s spending)
dashboard.noBudgets: No active budgets. Create one to track spending against a limit.

accounts.emptyDescription: Add a checking, savings, credit card, or cash account to start tracking balances.
accounts.deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone. Accounts with existing transactions cannot be deleted — archive it instead.
accounts.balanceFixed: Cannot change once created — reconcile the account instead

reconcile.title: Reconcile
reconcile.intro: The ledger says {{balance}}. Enter what the bank statement says, and we will tell you whether the two agree.
reconcile.dateHint: Reconciling the same date again replaces that entry.
reconcile.balanceHint: Negative for an overdraft or a card you owe on.
reconcile.freezeHint: Only happens when the two balances agree.
reconcile.matchedFroze_one: {{count}} transaction is now reconciled and can no longer be edited or deleted.
reconcile.matchedFroze_other: {{count}} transactions are now reconciled and can no longer be edited or deleted.
reconcile.matchedNoneFrozen: No transactions needed freezing up to that date.
reconcile.mismatchLedgerLower: The bank says {{statement}} and the ledger says {{ledger}}, so the bank knows about something this workspace does not — most often an income or a refund nobody entered.
reconcile.mismatchLedgerHigher: The ledger says {{ledger}} and the bank says {{statement}}, so this workspace holds something the bank does not — most often a payment that has not cleared yet, or one entered twice.
reconcile.empty: This account has never been reconciled.

transactions.deleteTransferDescription: Delete “{{description}}”? Both legs of the transfer go together — the server removes the matching row on the other account too.
transactions.editTransferTooltip: Edit description, date, status and tags
transactions.deleteTransferTooltip: Delete both legs of this transfer
transactions.recordedAsBase: Recorded as {{amount}} in the workspace’s base currency at the rate on the day.
transactions.splitNeedsMembers: Splitting needs someone to split with. Invite another member to this workspace from Settings first.
transactions.splitAmountRequired: Enter an amount for everyone included.
transactions.weightExplainer: Shares are worked out in proportion — 2 and 1 means two thirds and one third. Blank counts as 1.
transactions.transferExplainer: Records both sides at once: money leaving one account and arriving in the other. It counts as neither income nor expense.
transactions.destinationAmountHint: Leave empty to convert at the stored rate
transactions.transferStatusHint: Pending until it clears both accounts
transactions.noTagsYet: No tags yet — create one from “Manage tags”
transactions.noTagsExplainer: No tags yet. Tags are a free-form second axis alongside categories — “reimbursable”, “holiday 2026”, “shared”.

budgets.emptyDescription: Set a limit on one or more expense categories to start tracking spend against a plan.

goals.emptyDescription: Set a savings target and track contributions toward it over time.

recurring.emptyMessage: Nothing scheduled. Add a recurring bill or income to have it show up automatically on the ledger.
recurring.leadTimeHint: Days before due date to create a pending row

alerts.scanClean: Scan complete — nothing new to flag.
alerts.channelRequired: Choose at least one delivery channel

budgetThreshold.label: Budget threshold
budgetThreshold.description: Warn when a budget line crosses a percentage of its limit.

budgetExceeded.label: Budget exceeded
budgetExceeded.description: Notify as soon as a budget line goes over its limit.

largeTransaction.label: Large transaction
largeTransaction.description: Flag a single transaction that is unusually large.
largeTransaction.multipleOfAverageHint: e.g. 3 = flag spend 3× the recent average
largeTransaction.lookbackDaysHint: Window used to compute the average

unusualSpending.label: Unusual spending
unusualSpending.description: Z-score anomaly detection against a category’s own history.
unusualSpending.minMonthsHint: Needs at least 3 to be meaningful

duplicateTransaction.label: Duplicate transaction
duplicateTransaction.description: Catch two very similar transactions posted close together.
duplicateTransaction.windowDaysHint: How close together counts as a duplicate

billDue.label: Bill due
billDue.description: Remind ahead of a recurring bill’s due date.

goalMilestone.label: Goal milestone
goalMilestone.description: Celebrate a savings goal crossing a percentage of its target.

lowBalance.label: Low balance
lowBalance.description: Warn when an account balance drops below a floor.

reports.noSpending: No spending recorded in this month.
reports.noAccounts: This workspace has no accounts yet.
reports.noBudgets: No budget was active in this period.
reports.exportExplainer: A CSV of the ledger, with both the original and base-currency amounts. Leave the filters empty to export everything.

settings.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. Changing your email address is not supported yet.
settings.passwordExplainer: Changing your password signs you out everywhere, including here.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Every session has been signed out.
settings.workspaceAdminHint: These settings apply to everyone in this workspace.
settings.workspaceViewerHint: Only an admin can change these settings.
settings.baseCurrencyHint: Every converted total is reported in this currency
settings.baseCurrencyWarning: Transactions already recorded keep the base-currency amount they were converted to when they were created.
settings.workspaceTimezoneHint: Decides when a day rolls over for schedules and reports
settings.archiveExplainer: It disappears for every member. Nothing is deleted — the data stays on the server — but there is no way to bring it back from this screen.
settings.membersAdminHint: Roles take effect immediately, on every device that member is signed in on.
settings.membersViewerHint: Only an admin can change roles or remove members.
settings.inviteExplainer: The invitee gets an email with a link that expires. They join with the role you pick here.
settings.noInvitations: No invitations have been sent from this workspace.
settings.yourDataExplainer: A machine-readable copy of everything tied to your account — every workspace you belong to, and the transactions, budgets and goals in them.
settings.sessionsExplainer: Signs you out of every browser and device, this one included. Use it if you have signed in somewhere you no longer control.
settings.signOutAllDescription: Every signed-in device, including this one, will be signed out. You will need to sign in again.
settings.deleteAccountExplainer: Your profile is anonymised and every session ends. Workspaces you own alone go with you; shared ones are archived, so the other members’ history stays coherent. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountDescription: This anonymises your profile and ends every session. It cannot be undone. Download your data first if you want a copy.

roleDescription.owner: Full control, including transferring ownership and archiving the workspace
roleDescription.admin: Manage members, invitations, workspace settings and alert rules
roleDescription.editor: Create and edit accounts, transactions, budgets and goals
roleDescription.viewer: Read-only access to everything in the workspace

imports.title: Import transactions from a file
imports.explainer: Download a statement from your bank as CSV, choose which account it belongs to, and drop it here. Nothing is written until you have seen exactly what will happen.
imports.accountHint: Every row in the file lands in this account.
imports.dropzone: Drop a CSV file here, or click to choose one
imports.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than {{limit}} KB. Split it and import in parts.

sign.signedHint: Negative means money left the account
sign.debit_creditHint: Two columns, one filled per row
sign.direction_flagHint: Always positive, with a marker column

imports.dateAmbiguous: Every date in this file reads either way round, so the layout cannot be worked out from the file itself. Check it before importing — the wrong choice moves rows by up to eleven months.
imports.mappingRecalled: Using the column mapping from the last import into this account.
imports.noRows: Nothing to import from this file.
imports.duplicateOfLine: Same as line {{line}} of this file
imports.duplicatesExplainer: Suspected duplicates start unticked. They are flagged, not removed — two identical charges on one day are a real pair, so the choice is yours.
imports.doneDescription: They are in the ledger now, tagged as one batch so they can be undone together.
imports.undoneDescription: Every row from that batch has been removed and the balance is back where it was.
